reason: Only a horse ridden by unnamed gods to Yggdrasil. Golden is etymology c02/c08, not documented luminous/golden bodily trait or power. Ordinary horse in mythical scenery fails subject distinction; no giant size or unique anatomy invented.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. artistic_choices: Decline before generation rather than add undocumented anatomy or power.
